programme.title: E411 - Arcade Trouble/Alarm Bean/Operation Wicket/Supermarket Ride/Bean’S Blooms
programme.desc: At an amusement arcade, Teddy accidentally gets put in a claw machine as a prize!

programme.title: E85 - The Scam/The Vacation
programme.desc: At Halloween show-and-tell, the class isn't buying Gumball's story about Gargaroth The Devourer until Carrie fakes a terrifying haunting. The kids convince the school to hire them as ghost exterminators, and take their payment in Halloween candy. But when it turns out Gargaroth is real, suddenly Gumball is expected to be the town's saviour.

programme.title: E111 - Birthday Bear/The Mole/Roadworks/Sofa/Treasure!
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is shocked when Teddy receives a birthday card from Bean’s girlfriend, Irma Gobb. The bear’s Birthday had completely slipped his mind. And what do you get for the teddy that has everything?

programme.title: E121 - Ask Not What Bunnies Can Do For You
programme.desc: It’s student council elections at Acme Loo! Babs and Buster both run for President, and they enlist Sweetie and Hamton as their respective campaign managers. That just leaves Plucky…who happily revels in the drama!

programme.title: E1356 - Porch Pirates/A Sticky Situation/The Perfect Pitch?/Pool Season/Kyle
programme.desc: After their package is stolen, the Titans must join a crew of porch pirates to get it back.

programme.title: E314 - Extreme Dominos/Surprise Deglaciation/Thermal Lemmings/Substitute Egg/Lemmings Conste
programme.desc: The Lemmings have set up a long line of dominos in the cabin that ends with several giant ice blocks and a rocket outside. Weary of not finding the peace and calm he loves so dearly, Grizzy sabotages the game.

programme.title: E6 - Rear Window
programme.desc: Tess gives the day off to a sleep-deprived Sunny before getting pulled into a nail-biting 911 call with an injured man locked in a steel drum who has no idea where... or who he is! As Tess navigates motives of revenge and business rivalry in a race against time to uncover the location of the soon-to-be murder victim and save his life, Sunny tricks Kye and obtains his security code, obsessively monitoring her neighbours on the building's CCTV cameras, convinced she witnessed a murder. Tess and Sunny are reunited in an emotional climax, but are left to face the aftermath alone- Tess overwhelmed by information she shared about her past in an act of empathy, and Sunny confronted by Kye about her spiraling mental health.

programme.title: E8 - Hindsight
programme.desc: A case comes to haunt Tess when a righteous lawyer challenges her testimony about a home invasion gone wrong, threatening to overturn the conviction and Tess's future with the force – all on the basis of her vision loss. When Bennett takes Tess off the case to contain a potential scandal, Tess finds an unexpected ally in Owen, but she and Sunny are left wondering about their future, and worse: did Tess put an innocent man in jail? Tess leans on Matt and Mia, while Sunny grows hilariously defensive with her new therapist.

programme.title: E6 - Gold, Frankincense, And Murder
programme.desc: Celebrity Christmas curators Dirk and DeeDee Dashers go from tinsel to tragedy after Dirk is killed.

programme.title: E10 - Rekindling
programme.desc: Amidst the effervescence of Lucas's wedding day, Tess plays with fire as she uses Jake's undercover investigation to get close to the man she holds responsible for her mother's death. In this epic finale, Tess must challenge everything she thought she knew about her past to finally learn the truth about the fire that killed her mother and separated her from Lucas. Meanwhile, after spontaneously reaching out to her estranged mother in 209, Sunny continues to push boundaries in an attempt to convince herself she is cured, first sleeping with Kye, and then inviting the wolf to her door in the form of her mother – with unexpected consequences.

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.title: E12
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 《唐人街探案2》中海外再發多起奇案，唐仁大弟子林默、天才黑客Kiko紛紛登場，更有眾多新偵探新人物亮相！為探尋真相，老偵探再集結重掀唐人街風雲！懸疑故事幽默風格深刻寓意，呈現探案新潮流。

programme.title: E38
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E34
programme.desc: 《唐朝詭事錄》講述了在繁華的大唐盛世之下發生的一系列奇聞異事，長安金吾衛中郎將盧凌風將與狄公親傳弟子蘇無名攜手共破詭案，守護蒼生，擔負起挽救社稷於危急的使命。

programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E7
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: E30
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 延續無修音、無剪輯、無劇本的核心底色，助力好歌破圈，並在內容編排、歌曲推薦體系等方面進行煥新升級；邀請了胡夏、姚曉棠、姚弛、王櫟鑫、小鬼-王琳凱、付辛博、劉端端、吉克雋逸...等超強陣容，打造一場全天候的真音樂狂歡派對。

programme.title: E4 - 沈騰狼人殺玩心眼
programme.desc: 明星戶外旅居真人秀，由沈騰攜手「出發家族」白敬亭、賈冰、金晨、宋亞軒、胡先煦和王安宇等新老朋友開啟歡樂野遊之旅，體會當地人的日常生活，感受各地自然山水的風景名畫，治愈當下的焦慮，感受到大自然及好朋友在一起的快樂。

programme.title: E6 - 「特種兵」行程累懵胡軍李乃文
programme.desc: 兩位50+娛樂圈前輩胡軍、李乃文化身為經理人團隊，為具有代表性的年輕後輩藝人擔任經理人，全面負責藝人的行程安排，從接送機、行程對接、妝髮準備到工作陪伴、突發危機處理...等；他們需要動用自己的人生智慧和圈內經驗，為藝人保駕護航。

programme.title: E49
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: E11 - 超般配男女嘉賓
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手。

programme.title: E1 - Lionfish
programme.desc: The white sand beaches and emerald green waters of Destin, Florida are the setting for the 'World's Luckiest Fishing Villages.' Beneath the water's surface, it's a different story...one of the most formidable species, the lionfish, has been wreaking havoc on the local ecosystem for decades. The ecological advantage of the lionfish is its venomous spikes, used to corner prey and protect itself from predators, and giving it an advantage over native fish. Luckily, local conservationists and fishing captains discovered years ago that lionfish are as tasty as they are dangerous. Yia joins local biologist Alex Fogg as he works to mitigate the lionfish's damage by harvesting them one buttery, flaky bite at a time.

programme.title: E3 - Burmese Pythons
programme.desc: If you asked experts what the most prevalent predator species in the United States is, without hesitation, the answer would be the Burmese pythons in the Florida Everglades. Growing up to 26-feet long and weighing as much as 200 pounds, the Burmese python has completely altered the ecosystem of the Everglades by eliminating over 99% of the native mammal population. To save the 'Glades, the hunter has become the hunted as Dusty 'Wildman' Crum has made it his mission to eradicate this species. Luckily for Yia, python is considered a delicacy in many countries, and Dusty believes these constrictors should be restricted to life on a plate, which helps take a bite out of the problem.

programme.title: E1 - Polar Bear
programme.desc: Henry is no ordinary polar bear. Born at Sea World on the Gold Coast, Australia, it was planned from day one that he would eventually make the journey to the small-town of Cochrane in Ontario, Canada, where he can live like a wild polar bear. The town folk of Cochrane decided they wanted the polar bear as its mascot, so they built an amazing polar bear facility. But there was one problem, they didn’t have a polar bear. Back at Sea World, Queensland, Henry is now an adult and after months of crate training and logistical planning, departure day arrives. The first leg is to Sydney but with no plane equipped to carry a polar bear, the Australian military step in. He flies first-class with his keepers on a Hercules jet to Sydney. From Sydney to Hong Kong, then Hong Kong to Vancouver where the plane is delayed, and Henry has eaten all his food. There’s still a long way to go to Ontario and they need to feed this hungry polar bear. It’s 11pm and there’s a supermarket close to the

programme.title: The New Legend of Shaolin
programme.desc: Hung Hei Kwun, a kungfu student of Shaolin, is against the Manchu rulers. Hung's whole family was arrested and later beheaded. Hung killed Ning-Erh Ma in revenge and escaped with his youngest son, Man-Ting, to nowhere land. Several years later, Chishan, Father Superior of the Shaolin Temple, found a map to a treasure trove but contents were tattooed on the backs of his five young masters. If missing one master, the trove could not be found...

programme.title: Superstars Sunday: Picture Of A Nymph
programme.desc: There is the Taoist Priest who saves a baby from the floods and names him Shih Erh. Shih Erh grows up and becomes the Priest's assistant in fighting evil spirits. One day, Shih Erh destroys the Scholar's home by mistake. The Scholar Tsui Hung-Chien has to move in with the Priest and Shih Erh. Mo Chiu was once abducted by the King Ghost, she chose death over captivity but even as a ghost, the King Ghost wouldn't leave her alone. She sent other ghosts to get her. The Scholar meets Mo Chiu and paints the picture of Mo Chiu. When the King Ghost chases Mo Chiu away, she escapes and enters the picture. Mo Chiu finally meets the Scholar again and they fall in love...
